subject: calderMobile
pitch:
Category: Abstract.
Subject: hanging mobile.
Style: Alexander Calder.

requests.what: Add a small black forged suspension eye and a tiny warm brass cap above the mobile, keeping the Calder wire silhouette spare.
Add one small cobalt-blue folded paper-like abstract petal at the upper arm's outer end, with a narrow black connector.
Add a tiny matte yellow counterweight bead and a short black dangling pin beneath the right end of the upper arm.
Add a bold red circular Calder-style disc hanging just below the middle arm, with a black wire loop and a small offset yellow dot.
Add a thin mustard-yellow triangular fin to the far end of the middle arm, canted diagonally and held by one black wire.
Add a large deep-blue curved leaf plate beneath the lowest arm, with one lighter blue inset crescent and a black suspension line.
Add a small off-white diamond shard at the left end of the lowest arm, floating from a thin black thread.
Add a bright orange narrow comma-shaped plate beneath the blue leaf, offset to one side so the counterweight feels deliberately unbalanced.
Paint the red plate with a very simple flat vermilion field and one small cream geometric notch near its upper edge; keep the finish matte and graphic.
Paint the blue leaf in two flat cobalt tones: deep blue overall with one broad lighter-blue crescent following the plate's curved edge.
Add two broad mustard and ochre wedges to the yellow fan, with no gradients, no text, and a hand-cut paper quality.
